mapper.sql: SELECT g.resource_id, g.scope_code FROM plt_authorization_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND g.deleted = b'0' AND g.subject_type_code = 'USER' AND g.subject_id = #{query.readScope.projectScope.subjectUserId} AND g.resource_context_code = 'PROJ' AND g.resource_type_code = 'PROJECT' AND g.action_code IN ('PROJECT_VIEW', 'PROJECT_MANAGE') AND g.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND g.current_marker = 1 AND g.effective_from <= #{query.readScope.projectScope.effectiveAt} AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to > #{query.readScope.projectScope.effectiveAt})
